when_to_use: At project start, to detect project state and equip the correct kit
Whenever work needs roles, gates, and workflow law enforced
At session start or after context loss, to rebuild the working anchor
Before any execution, to verify the machine and block on critical failures
When a page needs weighted inertial smooth scrolling, or Lenis scroll janks, drifts, desyncs from a canvas or ScrollTrigger, or stops
When an Open Graph social preview card must be designed and rendered, or one renders blank, unstyled or differently on each run
When adding, editing or reviewing a Next App Router opengraph-image or twitter-image file, before the route fails at runtime
Before a scoped change enters implementation, to name its failure modes and convert each into a cheap guard
When code reads the clock, checks an expiry, compares a date or stores a timestamp, so the test still passes years from now
Before a kit component is tried, adopted, kept or dropped, to record the attempt and its score in the evaluation journal
Before a plan, design or diff ships, to attack it deliberately and rank the holes by damage rather than by list order
Before an untried procedure is adopted or trusted with consequences, to rehearse it in shadow mode against real inputs
When a documented command, snippet, path or configuration key will be relied on, so the example is executed rather than trusted
When a kit component is added, changed, retired or re-scoped, to append the reason once and never rewrite it
Before work that could be stopped, paused or rolled back unsafely begins, to write down the halt steps, their authority and their verification
When intent crosses a vocabulary boundary such as business language to implementation terms, so the translation is written down and reversible
When an agent lands on a machine that has never carried the Arsenal, to read the system, its repository and its tree before any project work
When a design task arrives on a UI-bearing project and the styling work has not been written yet, to produce four screenshot-able variations and an owner approval before implementation
At each task start, before execution, to author the standing methodology and fix the workflow before the first dispatch
